    si."Block",
    COUNT(DISTINCT si."School Code") AS schools_no_electricity,
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN si."Electricity" = 'No' THEN 
                COALESCE(se."Girls 2024", 0) + COALESCE(se."Boys 2024", 0)

    school_infrastructure si

    si."Electricity" = 'No'
GROUP BY 
    si."Block";
